name: National Education Policy, 2020
change: Introduced multidisciplinary education, flexible degree structures, and integration of digital learning platforms across institutions.
impact: Improves flexibility and encourages interdisciplinary learning. Enhances employability but requires institutional restructuring.

name: National Digital Education Architecture (NDEAR), 2021
change: Creation of a unified digital infrastructure for education including platforms for content delivery, student data management, and teacher training.
impact: Enables scalable digital learning and better governance. Raises concerns about data privacy and access inequality.

name: PM eVIDYA Programme, 2020
change: Launch of multi-mode digital education including TV channels, online platforms, and mobile apps to support remote learning.
impact: Expands access to education during disruptions like pandemics. Limited effectiveness in areas with poor connectivity.

name: SWAYAM Online Education Initiative, 2017
change: Provides free online courses from top institutions with credit transfer options for higher education students.
impact: Promotes self-paced learning and increases access to quality education. Requires learner motivation and digital access.

name: National Skill Development Mission, 2015
change: Focus on vocational training, industry partnerships, and skill certification programs aligned with job market needs.
impact: Improves employability and workforce readiness. Implementation varies across regions.

name: AI in Education Initiative, 2024
change: Integration of AI concepts and tools into school and college curricula, including machine learning basics and ethical AI practices.
impact: Prepares students for future technologies and promotes innovation. Requires teacher upskilling and infrastructure support.

name: Academic Bank of Credits System, 2021
change: Allows students to store and transfer academic credits across institutions and courses digitally.
impact: Provides flexibility in education pathways and supports lifelong learning. Needs strong institutional coordination.

name: Samagra Shiksha Scheme, 2018
change: Integrated scheme covering school education from pre-primary to senior secondary levels with focus on inclusive education.
impact: Improves school infrastructure and access to education. Implementation quality varies by state.

name: National Research Foundation Proposal, 2020
change: Establishment of a central body to fund and promote research across disciplines, including emerging technologies.
impact: Boosts innovation and research output. Encourages collaboration between academia and industry.

name: Digital University Initiative, 2022
change: Creation of a fully digital university offering online degrees and courses with standardized content delivery.
impact: Expands access to higher education nationwide. Raises concerns about quality assurance and digital divide.
